title: The tangent space of an embedded C¹ d-submanifold is a d-dimensional subspace
statement: For all P, d ∈ ℕ, every M ⊆ ℝ^P that is an embedded C¹ d-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 d M) and every x ∈ M, tangentSpace M x is a linear subspace. Precisely, the linear span of tangentSpace M x has carrier exactly tangentSpace M x, and this span has dimension d.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 d M → x ∈ M → (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x) : Set (Euclid P)) = tangentSpace M x ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)) = d
